# heuristic API route extraction can yield false positives/incomplete handler info

API endpoints are detected via a regex that looks for expressions like '<obj>.<verb>("/path"...)' and emits api_endpoint_observed with handler set to null and source 'code_pattern'. This heuristic can produce false positives or omit handler details because it operates on raw file text rather than AST semantics.
